'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
